```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'
    branches:
      - 'master'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3

      - name: Check if base version already exists in Maven
        run: |
          VERSION=$(cat airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/version.properties | grep 'version=' | cut -d'=' -f2)
          echo "Checking for version: $VERSION"
          
          # Check if the version exists in the Maven repository
          # Using curl to check the metadata file for the specific version
          MAVEN_URL="https://connectors.airbyte.com/maven-releases/io/airbyte/cdk/bulk-cdk-core-base/${VERSION}/bulk-cdk-core-base-${VERSION}.pom"
          
          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$MAVEN_URL")
          
          if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "Version $VERSION already exists in Maven repository. Skipping publish."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Version $VERSION does not exist in Maven repository. Proceeding with publish."
          fi

      - name: Build Base Package
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:build

      - name: Publish Base Package
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:publishToMavenLocal
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:publish
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
```
